name: datGetBaseMaxHp
evidence: (level + param[3]) * 6; cap 999 unless flag 0x20.
differences: HD reads managed object fields.

name: datGetBaseMaxMp
evidence: (level + param[2]) * 3; cap 999 unless flag 0x20.
differences: PS2 computes through software floating point; HD uses integer arithmetic.

name: datGetNormalAtkPow
evidence: (level + param[0]) * 2; halve when (badstat & 0xFFF) == 0x40.
differences: HD inlines parameter lookup.

name: datGetMagicHitPow
evidence: param[2] * 2 + level + (param[5] + 5) / 2 + 15.
differences: Earlier PS2 routines at 00242bc8 and 00242c48 remain unnamed.

name: datGetDefPow
evidence: (level + param[3]) * 2.
differences: HD inlines parameter lookup.

name: datGetSakePow
evidence: Integer conversion of (param[4] + 5) * 1.5 + (param[5] + 5) + (level + 5).
differences: PS2 software double arithmetic; HD rearranges arithmetic and conversion.

name: GetButuriAttack
evidence: Branch on flag 0x20 and skill zero; constants 1.33, 23.2, 0.6, 0.8; level-dependent correction.
differences: PS2 contains unused attack/defence helper results; HD inlines helpers.

name: GetButuriKaifuku
evidence: PS2 forwards all four arguments to GetButuriAttack; HD performs the same calculation.
differences: HD duplicates/inlines the calculation.

name: GetMagicAttack
evidence: Skill stride 0x3C; capped skill base + 2 * level * waza / 21; magic and flag corrections.
differences: PS2 software double and HD float operations need separate precision validation.

name: GetMagicKaifuku
evidence: (param[2] * 4 + level + random(8)) / 10 * waza.
differences: Same formula structure; random generator not identified here.

name: GetMaxHpWazaPoint
evidence: Maximum HP / 69.6 * waza; flag 0x20 selects base HP and correction.
differences: Floating point precision differs between platforms.

name: GetAisyoRitu
evidence: Attribute record stride 8; -1 and 12..14 return 1; other cases multiply affinity low halfword by 0.01.
differences: HD obtains attribute and affinity through managed tables.

name: datGetSkillKouka
evidence: HP/MP selector; 16 formula cases; physical/magic dispatch; ailment mask 0xFFF; affinity scaling; signed damage/healing.
differences: HD inlines multiple helpers; floating point behavior needs independent validation.

name: datGetSkillBadKouka
evidence: Status mask 0xFFF; mode 3 selects one of 12 bits; affinity immunity 0x170000; chance and flag 0x20 correction.
differences: HD uses managed skill tables.

name: datExecSkill
evidence: Compute HP, MP and status effects; apply/clamp; zero HP sets status 0x800; effects 8..11 set global bits 1,2,4,8.
differences: HD inlines application helpers and includes managed checks.

name: datOverwriteBadStat
evidence: Status 0x8000 is ORed; otherwise preserve high 0xF000 and replace low 0xFFF.
differences: HD adds status bookkeeping outside the retained core.

name: datSetBadStat
evidence: Status 0x8000 is ORed; low 0xFFF is replaced only if the new value is larger.
differences: HD adds status bookkeeping and achievement calls.

name: datResetBadStat
evidence: Halfword status at work+0xE is ANDed with the complement of the supplied mask.
differences: HD inlines this operation at several call sites.

name: datGetBaseParam
evidence: Signed bytes at 0x16, 0x1C and, unless flag 4, 0x7A; clamp sum to 1..40.
differences: HD stores these values in managed arrays.

name: datGetParam
evidence: Base parameter lookup; status 0x200 forces value 1 unless parameter index 4; minimum 1.
differences: HD inlines base parameter lookup.

name: datCheckSyojiSkill
evidence: Flag 0x20 selects devil-format skills; otherwise count at 0x38 and halfword skills at 0x3A.
differences: HD skill list uses managed integer arrays and a different layout.

name: datGetAisyo
evidence: Packed affinity word; attr -1 returns 0; 0x40-byte rows; flag 4 selects row zero; status 0x400 overrides row.
differences: HD XOR constants resolve to 0xFFF and 0x400 from disk; table access differs.

name: datGetAisyoFlag
evidence: Return packed affinity & 0xFFFF0000.
differences: PS2 low-halfword wrapper 00244078 remains unnamed.

name: datGetBadStatusAttr
evidence: Same bit-to-attribute map for statuses 1..0x400; HD encoded constants independently decoded from disk.
differences: HD maps 0x800 to attribute 5 and gates higher statuses through cfgGetBit(9); PS2 returns -1 for 0x800.

name: datCheckDying
evidence: Integer HP * 100 / maxHP < 25.
differences: HD adds a null check and event-bit exclusions E80/E83.
